scope.goal: Instantiate and prove the governed v0.14.0 source candidate across v0.13.0, v0.9.0, and v0.6.0 retained origins, then terminal-close Issue #206.
scope.target: v0.14.0 release record, notes, migration, phase contract, support matrix, route evidence, package identity, release validators, and UPG-003 terminal evidence
constraints: Use exactly one online Issue #206 and this one technical workflow across S1, S2, and S3.
Use the exact Included Work snapshot #200 through #208 in order; #209 remains traceability-only.
Prove one-entrypoint routes for v0.13.0, v0.9.0, and v0.6.0 without manual sequential application.
Keep release and workflow records source-only; do not place them in downstream provenance or packages.
Keep #206 open until the admitted S3 PR merges and keep coordination Issue #222 open.
Do not claim Project-field restoration from this workflow.
non_goals: Create or modify a GitHub Release
Modify an external repository or local historical backlog/roadmap

architecture_decisions: S1 owns read-only route resolution and S2 owns target-local transaction semantics; S3 supplies exact release assets and proof rather than reimplementing them.
Concrete release support matrix and route evidence remain source-only under .dev/releases/v0.14.0.
Candidate source validation and post-merge provider closure are separate evidence boundaries.
user_constraints: Release notes may mention #209 only as a defect correction.
The S3 PR terminal-closes #206 and defers coordination Issue #222.
No tag, Release, asset/package publication, nightly activation, Project restoration, or external mutation.

steps: Instantiate canonical v0.14.0 release records and exact online Issue snapshot.
Build and bind one source-specific v0.14.0 candidate package for all retained origins.
Create and verify the support matrix, edge receipts, and route evidence.
Reconcile release validation so source proof and post-merge provider closure remain fail closed.
Commit, independently audit, pass hosted checks, terminal-close #206, and read back integration.
validation: candidate release record and canonical authored files
missing or tampered asset and semantic-cutover bypass rejection
exact-head independent audit and hosted terminal admission
execution.commit_checkpoint: One terminal-close S3 PR using Closes #206 and retaining Issue #222 open.
deferred_items: Cumulative merged-main release profile and pre-tag readiness verdict under Issue #222

results.summary: The Phase-A v0.14.0 source-candidate scaffold and fail-closed release-state contract are locally validated; immutable-commit package construction and retained-origin route proof remain in progress.

test_execution.evidence: Sandbox Windows TEMP fixture creation failed with WinError 5 before product assertions.

Normal Windows ACL rerun passed 3/3 in 0.052 seconds after the first semantic run exposed and the implementation repaired canonical Windows route bytes plus the narrow read-only pull-request endpoint allowlist.
Normal Windows ACL full focused module passed 36/36 in 0.742 seconds.

The immutable Phase-A build failed before package creation because the builder canonicalized migration sources to numeric ascending order while release.yaml declared descending order; no package or route PASS evidence was produced.
First full run passed 23/24; GWT017 retained the superseded immediate-predecessor diagnostic text after the governed-source message was generalized.
After correcting only the stale diagnostic assertion, the normal Windows ACL module passed 24/24 in 1.332 seconds.
Source version governance passed for 17 release records with the explicit v0.14.0 retained-source horizon.

The corrected immutable build failed before archive output because portable .dev/standards/INDEX.MD linked the source-only excluded GITHUB-TERMINAL-ISSUE-CLOSURE-POLICY.md; no package or route PASS evidence was produced.
Focused source-only navigation projection guard passed 1/1 in 0.032 seconds.

validation_evidence: Local main and origin/main were clean and equal at bf8ad9c624ffc2154722dfb266c9090c72e4ac5f before the S3 branch.
Framework-source packet resolved with AICTX-EVIDENCE-001 and TEST-GWT-001; packet digest d01b6e5462fc645ada446a5edeef703059234713211fc6995e000da01d3cc700.
Live Issue #206 and coordination Issue #222 remain open; Project-field restoration is not claimed.

Phase-A release.yaml fixes the exact nine Included Work refs and automatic upgrade inputs v0.13.0, v0.9.0, and v0.6.0; it deliberately retains no support-matrix or route PASS evidence before an immutable package-build commit.

Release-state validation now requires canonical source-only route receipts and accepts an open terminal Issue only when exactly one tracked terminal-close declaration matches a live open PR at the current Git HEAD; post-merge provider closure remains mandatory.

The package builder requires automatic_upgrade_sources to equal the exact ordered migration-source set, so the candidate records all three retained origins rather than inventing an indirect route or omitting an input.

Immutable Phase-A build at 803a0771ada510a9c5faf630a36a096d74117a64 failed before package creation because builder canonical order is v0.6.0, v0.9.0, v0.13.0; the canonical template, release record, and active version-governance horizon now use that numeric order.

Immutable build at 7680190bf673c403ffbb970c75d397f91606872c then failed before archive output on a portable standards-index link to a source-only excluded terminal-close policy; the index now preserves the source-only filename as non-navigation text instead of weakening payload reference validation.
